title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule B: Renewal, Notice and Early Termination Terms
content:
Schedule B fixes, for each ClearPath Managed IT Services tier, the length of an automatic renewal term, the notice period, the renewal uplift cap, the early termination fee percentage and whether a downgrade may take effect mid-term.

## B.1 Terms defined

1. **Renewal term**: the length, in months, of each automatic renewal term.
2. **Notice days**: the calendar days of signed written notice required before term end for non-renewal, and the minimum notice for early termination.
3. **Renewal uplift cap**: the maximum increase of the per-seat rate applied at a renewal, as a percent of the expiring term's rate.
4. **Early termination fee percentage**: the early termination fee as a percent of the committed monthly fees remaining after the termination effective date.
5. **Mid-term downgrade**: whether a move to a lower tier may take effect before the current term ends.

## B.2 Tier table

| Tier | Renewal term | Notice days | Renewal uplift cap | Early termination fee percentage | Mid-term downgrade allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 12 months | 30 | 5 percent | 50 percent | No |
| ClearPath Essentials | 12 months | 60 | 5 percent | 50 percent | No |
| ClearPath Standard | 12 months | 60 | 5 percent | 60 percent | No |
| ClearPath Professional | 12 months | 90 | 5 percent | 75 percent | No |
| ClearPath Premier | 12 months | 90 | 4 percent | 75 percent | No |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 12 months | 120 | 3.5 percent | 80 percent | No |

## B.3 Notes on the table

- Every tier renews for 12 months, whatever the length of the initial term.
- No tier allows a downgrade to take effect before the current term ends.
- The same notice days figure serves both purposes in B.1 item 2: on ClearPath Essentials, a non-renewal needs 60 calendar days of signed written notice before term end, and an early termination needs at least 60 days of notice.

## B.4 Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical expiring per-seat rate of 100.00 on a tier with a 5 percent cap can rise at renewal to at most 105.00; with a 3.5 percent cap, to at most 103.50.
